labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports a failure in Rich's test suite with a newer Pygments; reads as a bug claim.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example, traceback, or Rich version; a minimal reproduction and rich.diagnose output are needed.

items.body:
Thanks for the report. To look into this, we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces the failure, plus your Rich version and platform. Running `python -m rich.diagnose` prints the environment report we use ([source](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/diagnose.py)). Please also paste the names of the failing tests and the short assertion message for each, since the full output is too long to post. If you can, try a minimal reproduction that does not depend on the Fedora test suite.

A closed earlier report about test failures with a newer Pygments version may be related: #3088.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
